name: ts-graphql-gateway
description: GraphQL gateway that federates two REST microservices (Users, Notes) into one schema, using DataLoader to fix the N+1 query problem.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n users,notes,gateway -c blue,green,magenta "tsx watch src/services/users.main.ts" "tsx watch src/services/notes.main.ts" "tsx watch src/gateway/index.ts"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n users,notes,gateway -c blue,green,magenta "node dist/services/users.main.js" "node dist/services/notes.main.js" "node dist/gateway/index.js"
